$comment: Schema for metadata.json file containing benchmark metadata and LMArena category information. The file is an array containing one meta_info entry and multiple benchmark/LMArena entries.
description: Array of metadata entries: first entry is meta_info, followed by benchmark entries and LMArena entries

oneOf.$comment: Meta info entry: contains definitions for prompt_length_standards, category_definitions, and scraping_method_definitions. This is always the first entry in the array.

meta_info.$comment: Metadata definitions used throughout the file

prompt_length_standards.$comment: Token range definitions for prompt length categories used in H3 hypothesis testing

category_definitions.$comment: Definitions for benchmark categories that map to LMArena ELO columns

^Coding|Math|Instruction Following|Creat.$comment: Category description explaining what types of tasks belong to this category

scraping_method_definitions.$comment: Definitions for different data acquisition methods

^pandas_read_html|selenium|artificial_an.$comment: Method description explaining how to acquire data using this method

oneOf.$comment: Benchmark entry: contains metadata for benchmarks that will be analyzed. These entries do NOT have an 'elo_column' field.

leaderboard_url.$comment: The endpoint URL where the benchmark leaderboard can be accessed

question_count.$comment: Integer number of questions in the benchmark

question_type.$comment: Description of the question type (supplementary information only, not used in analysis)

category.$comment: Category that determines the target LMArena ELO column for correlation analysis. Mapping: 'Coding' -> elo_coding, 'Math' -> elo_math, 'Instruction Following' -> elo_instruction_following, 'Creative Writing' -> elo_creative_writing, 'Hard Prompts' -> elo_hard_prompts, 'Expert' -> elo_expert

task_type.$comment: Task type classification: MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions), Generative (free-form text/code generation), Mixed (combines multiple task types)

prompt_length.$comment: Prompt length category used for H3 hypothesis testing. Token ranges are defined in meta_info.prompt_length_standards. Treated as categories (not numeric ranks) for Kruskal-Wallis test.

scraping_method.$comment: Data acquisition method. All output data files are named 'data.csv' and stored in the respective method directory under data/raw/. See meta_info.scraping_method_definitions for detailed descriptions.

oneOf.$comment: LMArena entry: contains metadata for LMArena leaderboard categories (Overall, Coding, Math, etc.). These entries have an 'elo_column' field and are processed using the 'lmarena' method. They should NOT be processed as benchmarks.

benchmark_name.$comment: The name of the LMArena category (e.g., 'LMArena (Chatbot Arena) - Overall')

leaderboard_url.$comment: The endpoint URL where the LMArena leaderboard can be accessed

category.$comment: LMArena category name. Note: LMArena entries may have 'category: Overall', but they should NOT be processed as benchmarks.

elo_column.$comment: The ELO column name in the master table that corresponds to this LMArena category. This field distinguishes LMArena entries from benchmark entries.
